verdict.rationale: The official README says Gemini CLI can "query and edit large codebases." It can pull extra directories into context (`--include-directories`) and supports project context files (GEMINI.md). One hands-on user reports throwing very large codebases at it and having it navigate and learn them effortlessly, leaning on the 1M-token context window. Another hands-on user calls its codebase navigation slow and poor, which lowers confidence but is a single brief trial rather than a documented failure of the capability. Missing for 10: first-party docs on architecture explanation or finding where to make changes, and consistent independent corroboration of navigation quality.
